_comment: Material-point loading paths for the parameter-sensitivity sweep.
These are NOT imported. The v2 contracts in the source copy define parameters
and dimensions but never a loading history, so a path had to be chosen here.
Choosing one is a scientific decision, so it is declared as reviewable data
rather than hidden in code, and every run records that the path is a pipeline
default rather than something the model's author specified.
The default is uniaxial strain along component 1: 20 increments of 1.0e-4,
reaching 2.0e-3 total axial strain. For a steel-like model (E ~ 2.1e5 MPa,
yield ~ 2.4e2 MPa) that predicts first yield near increment 12, so the path
exercises both the elastic and the inelastic branch. A model whose stiffness
or yield differs substantially will not reach yield under this path; that
shows up in the results as elastic-only coverage and must be read as a
limitation of the path, not as evidence that the model has no plastic branch.

default.rationale: uniaxial strain along component 1 to 2.0e-3 total, spanning elastic and inelastic response for steel-like moduli
default.chosen_by: pipeline default, not imported from the model contract
